patch_description:
This edit enhances the ansatz by:
1. Adding RX gates alongside RY gates for better single-qubit expressivity (rotation around different axis)
2. Introducing CCRZ gates for controlled three-qubit interactions (more flexible than ZZZ)
3. Keeping parameter sharing on pre/post RZ gates to maintain efficiency
4. Adding more three-qubit interactions to capture higher-order correlations
5. Maintaining the successful CRZ two-qubit gates from the current program

The rationale is that RX gates provide orthogonal rotations to RY, improving the expressivity of the single-qubit layer. CCRZ gates offer more controlled interactions than ZZZ, potentially better suited for the problem structure. More three-qubit interactions increase the circuit's ability to model complex relationships while parameter sharing keeps the parameter count reasonable.
